title: After A Year
style: melodic techno, emotional techno, 126 BPM, male baritone lead, spoken intro, vocal delay throws, stacked harmony chorus, sidechained sub bass, lo-fi synth bass, arpeggiated synths, atmospheric pads, punchy kick, crisp snare, gated reverb, stereo widening, distorted synth stab, dark euphoric, bittersweet nostalgia
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
After a year I saw you again
My mind went blank, I got locked in
Your smile is everything since it all began
I’m not illegal, but with you I was dreaming
Time keeps moving and I still don’t get tired
I had you just to show you off, I used to brag
I never do this, but for you I sang
I didn’t rest just to bring you back
[Pre-Chorus]
The kind of love that leaves and never comes back
I still want to be in that place where everything was
Even if it means losing, with you I fly too fast
Our plan was simple — grow old together, just us
[Chorus]
After some time everything changed
I had no idea how it all fell apart
What we had is gone, it’s just a memory now
I moved on, but you stayed behind somehow
I’m busy buying my mom the house she dreamed about
You’re just another one, I’m not looking back
The hard part is over, don’t hold on too tight
I’m single now, and I’m not on high alert tonight
[Verse 2]
I changed, I grew, I did what I had to do
You stayed the same while I was becoming someone new
I don’t hate you, but I don’t feel the same
The fire we had slowly turned into flames
I used to lose myself just to keep you alive
Now I’m focused on the things that help me survive
You were special once, but now you’re just a name
And I’m okay with that, I don’t feel the pain
[Chorus]
After some time everything changed
I had no idea how it all fell apart
What we had is gone, it’s just a memory now
I moved on, but you stayed behind somehow
I’m busy buying my mom the house she dreamed about
You’re just another one, I’m not looking back
The hard part is over, don’t hold on too tight
I’m single now, and I’m not on high alert tonight
[Outro]
After a year… I saw you again
But I’m not the same man I was back then
You stayed behind… while I kept moving
After a year… I finally stopped losing
